st: Heat [[2 tbsp]] oil in a heavy pot. Brown the beef and pork in batches, about 8 minutes total.
Add the onion and cook 4 minutes until soft.
Stir in the garlic and [[1 tbsp]] ginger for 1 minute, then add the tomatoes.
Pour in [[4 cups]] water, add [[1.5 tsp]] salt and [[0.5 tsp]] pepper. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer 1 hour 15 minutes until the meat is tender.
Stir in the chopped greens.
Simmer uncovered 10 minutes until the greens are soft and the broth is flavorful. Pork should reach 145°F (63°C) or higher.
Taste for salt and serve over white rice.
Pound or blend the cassava leaves in a food processor with a splash of water until finely minced.
Heat [[2 tbsp]] oil and brown the pork 8 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook 4 minutes.
Add the leaves with [[2 cups]] water, [[1.5 tsp]] salt and [[0.5 tsp]] pepper. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 1 hour 15 minutes, stirring now and then.
Pour in [[1 can]] coconut milk and simmer uncovered 20 minutes until thick. Pork should reach 145°F (63°C) or higher.
Serve the ravitoto hot with plenty of white rice.
Crush or process the cassava leaves to a coarse green paste.
Heat [[1 tbsp]] oil in a heavy pot and render the pork belly for 12 minutes until browned.
Add the onion, garlic and [[1 tbsp]] ginger and cook 4 minutes.
Add the leaves, [[3 cups]] water, [[1.5 tsp]] salt and [[0.5 tsp]] pepper.
Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer on low for 1 hour 30 minutes, stirring now and then.
Uncover and cook 15 minutes to thicken. Pork should reach 145°F (63°C) or higher and be very tender.
Serve with plenty of rice.
Season the chicken with [[1 tsp]] salt and [[0.5 tsp]] pepper.
Heat [[2 tbsp]] oil and brown the chicken 8 minutes. Set aside.
Cook the onion 4 minutes, then add the garlic and [[1 tbsp]] ginger for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook 5 minutes until broken down.
Return the chicken. Add [[1 cup]] water, [[0.5 tsp]] salt and turmeric. Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer uncovered 20 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) and the sauce thickens.
Serve the chicken and sauce over white rice.
Blanch the green beans in boiling water 3 minutes, then drain and rinse with cold water.
Put the carrots, cabbage, green beans and onion in a bowl.
Sprinkle with [[1 tsp]] salt and toss. Let sit 10 minutes.
Whisk [[3 tbsp]] vinegar, [[2 tbsp]] oil, [[1 tbsp]] lemon juice and [[0.25 tsp]] pepper.
Pour the dressing over the vegetables and add the chili if using.
Toss well, then chill 20 minutes. Serve with rice and grilled meat.
Wear gloves and remove the stems from the chilies. Seed some or all of them for less heat.
Peel the garlic and ginger.
Put the chilies, [[6 cloves]] garlic, [[3 tbsp]] ginger and [[1 tsp]] salt in a food processor.
Pulse until finely chopped into a coarse paste.
Heat [[0.5 cup]] oil gently in a small pan for 2 minutes.
Stir in the paste and cook on low for 5 minutes, stirring, until deeper in color and fragrant.
Cool and store in a clean jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.
Whisk [[2 cups]] rice flour, [[0.33 cup]] sugar, [[2 tsp]] yeast and [[0.25 tsp]] salt in a bowl.
Add [[1 cup]] coconut milk, [[1 cup]] warm water and [[1 tsp]] vanilla. Whisk to a smooth batter.
Cover and let rest 1 hour until bubbly.
Heat a muffin pan or round-hole pan over medium heat. Brush each cup with oil, using [[3 tbsp]] in total.
Pour batter into each cup, about three-quarters full.
Cover and cook 5 minutes until the tops set and the bottoms are golden.
Flip each cake and cook 3 more minutes. Serve warm with coffee or tea.

ing: or foil, cut in 10 inch squares
st: Grind [[2 cups]] peanuts in a food processor to a fine paste.
Mix with [[1 cup]] rice flour, the mashed bananas, [[0.5 cup]] sugar and [[0.25 tsp]] salt.
Add water, up to [[0.5 cup]], to make a thick, spreadable dough.
Soften banana leaves by passing them over a flame or soaking in hot water, and wipe dry.
Put a spoonful of dough in the middle of each leaf. Fold into a tight package and tie or tuck the edges.
Steam on a rack over simmering water for 1 hour 30 minutes, adding water as needed.
Cool, then unwrap and slice to serve.
Whisk [[1.5 cups]] flour, [[1 tsp]] baking powder, [[1 tsp]] salt and [[0.25 tsp]] pepper.
Slowly add about [[0.75 cup]] water to make a thick batter.
Stir in the greens, onion and chili.
Let the batter rest 10 minutes.
Heat [[2 cups]] oil to 350°F (175°C).
Drop in spoonfuls of batter and fry 3 minutes per side until golden and crisp.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
Put the beef bones, [[10 cups]] water and [[2 tsp]] salt in a large pot. Bring to a boil and skim off foam.
Reduce heat and simmer, partly covered, for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Lift out the bones and pull off the meat. Chop the meat and set aside.
Add the onion, leeks, carrots and garlic to the broth. Simmer 10 minutes.
Add the potatoes and tomatoes and simmer 15 more minutes until soft.
Return the meat to the pot with [[0.5 tsp]] pepper.
Stir in [[0.25 cup]] parsley and taste for salt. Serve hot.
